evals.name: webflow-export-with-variables
evals.prompt: Set up the style guide for this project from our Webflow site. The code export is at {INPUTS}/webflow-export. Match it exactly.
evals.expected_output: tokens.css and themes.css filled with the export's measured values under Trix names, the fluid range taken from the source, `npm run tokens` run, verify.ts reporting every check identical, decisions in PROJECT.md.
assertions: inventory.ts and design.ts were run against the export before any token was written
No Webflow variable name (--_spacing---, --_typography---, --_color---, --_theme---) appears anywhere under src/
--viewport-max equals the width at which the measured series stop growing, not Trix's default, when they differ
--site-margin, --site-gutter and --max-width-main come from proposal.md's Layout grid measurement, not Trix's defaults
Translucent colors were expressed as color-mix of an existing swatch or currentcolor, not as new swatches
The owner was asked every item on proposal.md's ask list in a single message before tokens were written
PROJECT.md → Design system lists the text-style map, spacing map, fluid range and quirks kept

evals.name: site-without-style-guide
evals.prompt: This client's site was hand-built years ago and has no style guide at all: https://example.com. Build a proper Trix design system from it without changing how it looks.
evals.expected_output: A complete tokens.css derived from measurement alone, with an ask list of consolidation decisions put to the user before writing, and every consolidated value reported with its delta.
assertions: Values come from design.ts measurements, not from reading CSS by name
No value differing by more than 0.5px from the measurement was written without the user's explicit approval
Every consolidated value is listed in the report with the original and new value
Text styles use Trix slot names (display, h1–h6, text-*, eyebrow), not the site's class names

evals.name: framer-stepped-type
evals.prompt: Match the type and spacing of our Framer site https://example.framer.website in Trix.
evals.expected_output: Breakpoint tokens set to the Framer site's measured breakpoints; stepped series reported and resolved with the user (kept stepped in component media queries, or made fluid between the breakpoint values).
assertions: --breakpoint-* tokens equal the site's measured media query widths
Stepped series were listed to the user rather than silently made fluid
No framer- class or --token- variable name appears under src/
